title: BeGin: Extensive Benchmark Scenarios and An Easy-to-use Framework for Graph Continual Learning
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical advancements in graph continual learning, introducing a benchmark framework, scenarios, and evaluating methods based on performance metrics (AP, AF, INT, FWT). While it mentions real-world applications such as drug discovery and sentiment classification, it does not include any evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethics.
